newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil weaker, buyers shy squeeze speculation.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil weaker, buyers shy squeeze speculation.

text.p: NWE gas oil outright prices were sharply weaker on Friday with speculation over a possible squeeze on prompt prices dulling already thin buying interest, traders said.
They said buyers were able to stay fairly relaxed despite prompt volatility with good supplies keeping differentials to the weaker benchmark IPE gas oil futures under pressure.

Speculation that a U.S. trade house was long futures and may be trying to force a squeeze on prices was read as a bullish sign for prices, but most felt it may liquidate contracts soon, if not with NYMEX heat expiry last today.

They said the trader had managed to take some good profit from keeping premiums artificially high for while, but the steep backwardation it had created to March gas oil futures was starting to discourage buyers.
"People are becoming worried about having high valued oil, relative to the March screen, in stock," a German importer said.
Traders said much of the key inland market was living on a "hand-to-mouth" basis with good supplies providing a cushion.
Reflecting this ,heating oil premiums were soft with refinery barges traded down to Feb IPE +$2 narrowing the refinery/storage differential to 25-50 cents.
